title: An example changes a familiar story

captions.energy: Checking the scale of a conclusion

meaning: Carefully examining a concrete example can reveal a new meaning within a shared story that you previously explained differently.
text: One visible detail can sometimes change the meaning of an entire story. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests gathering material for understanding: reconstructing an example, drawing a sketch and seeing how its parts connect. Justice in energy supports the wish to match a conclusion to what is actually known and give each observation an appropriate weight. Judgement in emotions experiences the discovery as a significant realisation. You may feel moved to reconsider your account of events because another connection has become apparent.

Suppose you think your walks together have become less interesting. Laying out a few recent routes on a simple diagram reveals that nearly every walk ended in a necessary errand. **A precise example can reveal meaning lost within a general assessment.** The impression now has another explanation: a leisurely walk gradually became a journey to get things done. This can resonate more strongly than the drawing itself. What you wanted to recover becomes clearer without declaring that interest in all your shared time has disappeared.

The vulnerable point is using one powerful discovery to explain every earlier walk anew. Wanting a final answer, you may give a particular observation too broad a significance. Your wish for an honest assessment remains supportive when the discovery retains its proper scale. A new understanding can matter for several evenings while leaving other memories their own reasons and shades of meaning.
